answer_1.quote: DocOwl2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on Multi-page Document understanding benchmarks with < 50% First Token Latency.
answer_1.outputs: question-answering performance and the First Token Latency (seconds)

answer_2.quote: We compare DocOwl2 with state-of-the-art MLLMs on 10 single-image document understand-ing benchmarks, 2 Multi-page document Understanding benchmarks, and 1 text-rich video understanding benchmark. Both question-answering performance and the First Token Latency (seconds) are considered to show the effectiveness of our model.
